name: Toga (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Toga village emblem in white: an outlined triangle enclosing a stylised character with horizontal strokes, like a mountain.
history: Flag of the former village of Toga in Toyama Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-11-01.

features.role: Toga village emblem — an outlined triangle enclosing a stylised character with horizontal strokes, like a mountain
